fixed.navigation_intent: Continue along the visible drivable road when permissible; obey visible signals and yield as needed. No map or future ego route is supplied.

revision_policy: Use the unchanged runner feedback payload from this window: concrete tool failure, previous native output and initial BODY-envelope conflicts. At most one semantic/tool revision. No GT, selection labels or earlier-window answers are injected; no filling/coercion/occupancy repair.
frozen_batch_policy: Keep prompt, input organization, Schema/wire, physical limits and planner unchanged through all six windows. If execution is interrupted, retain all results and report the incomplete batch; do not tune on the partial batch or replace failed windows.
activation_before_any_generation: Create a separate execution record after user authorization; do not overwrite this preparation.
Check all source/input/image SHA against the frozen registration.
Specify a new common deadline explicitly; the existing CLI default deadline is expired.
Only then read current rateLimits if supported; unavailable quota or 429 stops external requests.
Record actual requested/resolved model identity; unexposed server snapshot remains unknown.
stop_conditions: Schema-interface, authentication, quota, service or model-alias mismatch stops the batch; do not spend a semantic revision fixing the interface.
Evidence/source/input pin mismatch or runtime access to GT stops the batch.
Per-window2/global12 or wall limit ends requests without hidden retry, reset or replacement.
Native normal T1/T2/T3/T4 rejection may receive only the one preregistered tool-feedback revision.
Do not change algorithms or prompts mid-batch, switch account/model, or inherit old budgets.
known_limitations: Current frozen prompt still describes the old circumscribed-disk corridor, while actual selected planner is oriented-body with segment yaw bands. Preserve the text and disclose this mismatch; assess its impact after the batch, not presume it is a top problem.
Scene/category labels are human selection metadata only; signal state/ownership, lead relation and pedestrian interaction must come from the model.
Nominal2s front history has actual1.900011s span in night_straight due to recorded frame cadence; keep raw timestamps, no padding or invented frames.
Initial straight speed11.8806m/s is near fixed12m/s limit; do not clip the observed initial state.
Curated mini windows and historical exposure are not blind/unseen evaluation.
success_definition: Native real-image/model record plus T1-T4, independent acceptor, verified simulated0.2s prefix receipt/integration. Separately judge task behavior; JSON or unjustified stationary hold is not moving-task completion. Stationary waiting may be appropriate when model image evidence supports an applicable restriction/conflict.

gt_offline_review.objects_per_window: 1-2 decisive objects chosen from model/geometry evidence, with visible identity association; record missing/ambiguous/incomparable.
gt_offline_review.measurement_semantics: Fixed3.0.0-exp2 BODY-box center groundXY, dimensions and yaw, reference epoch and axes. No posthoc definition switching.
gt_offline_review.truth_boundary: Separate offline evaluation after runtime outputs are saved. No future images, maps, annotations, identities or GT numbers into runtime/feedback. Annotation interpolation is a surrogate, not continuous truth.

after_batch.failure_distribution: Two panels: final terminal status per unique window, and affected unique windows per diagnosed problem class across attempts. The latter may overlap. NOT_ATTEMPTED is neither failure nor success; revisions never add windows.
after_batch.candidate_failure_rule: Read every candidate_ledger row. If someT2PASS but noT3PASS, labelT3; if someT3PASS but noT4PASS labelT4. Never infer the whole-window stage from failures[-1]. Preserve each candidate reason.
after_batch.top_two_selection: Rank confirmed problem classes by affected unique-window count after the fixed batch. Retain service problems; external quota is not an algorithm fix. Ties use final blocking-window count, then evidence clarity. Do not invent two selected changes before observations.
after_batch.minimal_changes: One focused change per leading class with an explicit mechanism, counterexample and necessary regression. Planner-only changes use exactly the original nativeJSON for zero-call before/after, preserving all geometry/adverse modes/residuals/1m margin.
after_batch.prompt_input_changes: Separate configuration/group and real validation required; JSON replay cannot establish benefit of a changed prompt/input.

reserved_validation.policy: Fixed now, different scene tokens from all main windows; never substitutes a failed main window. After the two modifications, compare old/new planner with same returned JSON when applicable; at most initial+one revision per new window if separately authorized. No guaranteed pass and no unseen/blind claim.
